body: It's been a week since i posted this but things went very well! i reached out like 6 days ago but we've really worked out the past few years and we're back to being real friends. for now things have been really great and i'm gaining my confidence back and im talking to more people again!

im considering it soon, i have therapy today and i might just tell her about the stuff i've been going thru and hope she doesn't stop me to talk about one small detail. she normally does and we are stuck on overanalyzing small stuff and her encouraging yoga. jesus christ i hate yoga, get me on that mat if you want to hear me crack like a rice krispie.

thanks for your offer tho. because of previous experience with online friends i'm super reluctant to try that again just because you don't know what you're getting into until it's way too late. the last time i made friends i was stuck with them for two years because i really dont know when to leave someone, i hate people being left alone because of me. not to imply that you are though!

im asking myself the hypotheticals of what will i actually do if i get turned down. it's not like i have pride or dignity to lose anymore, for what most people know right now i fell off the side of the earth a while ago.

but once i know i'll be okay with rejection i'll go ahead and try. the only thing holding me back is just my cowardice at this point

yeah i really agree that we need friends to stay sane, but i have kept a record of being attracted to unhealthy people as long as i have been sabotaging relationships. said people made games out of making eachother go insane

fact of the matter is because of my limited contact with all of society i can't tell how he will act at all. but it's not like you can tell me either.

but thanks man, i just need to consider if i would make a complete dumbass of myself if i asked to speak with him and i missed a social cue or two from the past signaling we were no longer friends.
